item.text: The utility now accepts a cancellation-context flag: paid subscriptions in that context report the active subscription’s end date and plan title with renewal disabled, while free subscriptions return before the flag is considered. Both B2B and B2C cancellation confirmation date components now obtain their date from the utility. I’m running the existing helper test suite and checking formatting/types through the package’s available commands.
